target.title: fix: keep Android gateway settings save idempotent
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an Android regression where tapping Gateway Settings `Save & Connect` with an unchanged endpoint and blank credential fields could clear saved setup/device authentication and force a working phone back through pairing or capability approval.

The same credential decision was previously rebuilt by Settings, Connect, and Onboarding, so endpoint edits and explicit setup replacement could also carry or preserve the wrong credential family.

## Why This Change Was Made

All three entry points now produce one closed `GatewayConnectPlan`: preserve the current endpoint, replace the endpoint, or explicitly replace setup. `MainViewModel` is the sole owner of encrypted stored credentials and device-token resets.

- An unchanged endpoint with blank fields preserves encrypted token-, password-, or setup-based authentication.
- An endpoint change clears credentials from the old gateway before saving explicit replacement auth.
- Explicit setup replacement clears setup credentials and role device tokens only after confirmation.
- Hostname comparison is case-insensitive, and one credential family is selected deterministically.

The device-pairing copy also distinguishes gateway-admin phone pairing from the separate node capability approval flow.

## User Impact

Users can safely reconnect from Gateway Settings without destructive re-pairing. Credential changes remain explicit, stale credentials do not cross gateways, and setup replacement clearly warns before device approval state is reset.

## Evidence

- Exact candidate: `c5299264fe4cc6d81273c3714a66318b10788127`.
- Focused Play and third-party Android unit tests passed for `GatewayConfigResolverTest`, `OnboardingFlowLogicTest`, and `SettingsScreensTest`.
- Android ktlint passed; `:app:installPlayDebug` installed the candidate on an API 36.1 emulator.
- A no-op save was exercised against a real local OpenClaw Gateway: connection, node, endpoint, and ready state survived the reconnect with all credential fields blank. [Before/after proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98277#issuecomment-4871071209).
- Fresh autoreview passed after fixing endpoint-change leakage, in-memory token handling, bootstrap replacement, and case-only host edits; a final whole-branch review reported no findings.
- Contributor fake-Gateway evidence remains available in the [original proof bundle](https://gist.github.com/Solvely-Colin/59f308538a318ed72c4251d5e5c189db), including unchanged-save and setup-replacement flows.
- `git diff --check` passed.
